messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Error: could not find function "rhlm" while Linear regression
parts:
i dont recommend using rhlm anymore. Many things changed. You might want to look at the logic and rewrite the code yourself.
Essentially, it computes  (X'X)^{-1}X'Y

Get X via model.matrix and assuming the number of columns is not too large, compute X'X via map reduce. Be aware when using model.matrix the function is aware of /all/ levels of factors , not just those present in your split.

Compute X'Y

and ncol(model,matrix)) is not too large, X'X will be small.

I'm sure there are plenty of optimizations possible since the model matrix is very sparse (when factors are present).
